sys_hub_flow.description:
This flow will apply remote changes from source control on an application with a given sys_id on the provided instance.

Inputs:

  • Sys Id - Sys Id of the application on which you wish to apply changes from source control. To apply changes for customization for store application, provide Sys Id for the store application.
  • Instance URL - The URL of the Instance where app needs to be updated.
  • Credential Alias - The Connection and Credential alias must be of type "Credential" and must have user with "sn_cicd.sys_ci_automation" role."
  • Branch Name - Branch Name of the source control repo from which changes will be applied to application.
  • Auto Upgrade Base Application - This field will only be used when changes are applied for customization to store application. Should be set to false if base store app should not be upgraded if the latest Git commit to apply is built on newer version of base app than what is installed on the instance. Else leave it empty as default is true.
  • API Version - This optional parameter allows the version of the related CICD REST API to be specified. When not present, the latest version of the API will be used.

Outputs:

  • Status - Will be set to "0", if the request is "Pending". Will be set to "1", if the request is in "Running" state. Will be set to "2", if the request is "Successful". Will be set to "3", if the request is "Failed". Will be set to "4", if the request is "Cancelled”.
  • Error - Reason for error. Populated only when an error occurs.
  • HTTP Status - The HTTP status code of the response
  • Status Label - The label corresponding to the 'status'. Will be one of "Pending", "Running", "Successful", "Failed", "Cancelled"
  • Status Message - More information on why the operation failed if available. Can be empty.
  • Status Detail - More details on why the operation failed if available. Can be empty.
  • Stash ID - The sys_id of the sys_repo_stash record. Can be used to uniquely identify a stash from the sys_repo_stash records.
  • Stash URL - The URL of REST endpoint to apply the stashed changes from sys_id of the sys_repo_stash record.

To use this action, a corresponding CICD connection and credential must be created and associated with the Instance URL used above. Learn More

sys_hub_flow_snapshot.description:
This flow will apply remote changes from source control on an application with a given sys_id on the provided instance.

Inputs:

  • Sys Id - Sys Id of the application on which you wish to apply changes from source control. To apply changes for customization for store application, provide Sys Id for the store application.
  • Instance URL - The URL of the Instance where app needs to be updated.
  • Credential Alias - The Connection and Credential alias must be of type "Credential" and must have user with "sn_cicd.sys_ci_automation" role."
  • Branch Name - Branch Name of the source control repo from which changes will be applied to application.
  • Auto Upgrade Base Application - This field will only be used when changes are applied for customization to store application. Should be set to false if base store app should not be upgraded if the latest Git commit to apply is built on newer version of base app than what is installed on the instance. Else leave it empty as default is true.
  • API Version - This optional parameter allows the version of the related CICD REST API to be specified. When not present, the latest version of the API will be used.

Outputs:

  • Status - Will be set to "0", if the request is "Pending". Will be set to "1", if the request is in "Running" state. Will be set to "2", if the request is "Successful". Will be set to "3", if the request is "Failed". Will be set to "4", if the request is "Cancelled”.
  • Error - Reason for error. Populated only when an error occurs.
  • HTTP Status - The HTTP status code of the response
  • Status Label - The label corresponding to the 'status'. Will be one of "Pending", "Running", "Successful", "Failed", "Cancelled"
  • Status Message - More information on why the operation failed if available. Can be empty.
  • Status Detail - More details on why the operation failed if available. Can be empty.
  • Stash ID - The sys_id of the sys_repo_stash record. Can be used to uniquely identify a stash from the sys_repo_stash records.
  • Stash URL - The URL of REST endpoint to apply the stashed changes from sys_id of the sys_repo_stash record.

To use this action, a corresponding CICD connection and credential must be created and associated with the Instance URL used above. Learn More

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_hub_flow"><sys_hub_flow action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>public</access><acls/><active>true</active><allow_high_security_roles>false</allow_high_security_roles><annotation/><attributes/><authored_on_release_version/><callable_by_client_api>false</callable_by_client_api><category display_value="Source Control">a5bdd866773f3300d4bdaeca78106196</category><copied_from/><copied_from_name/><description><p>This flow will apply remote changes from source control on an application with a given sys_id on the provided instance. </p>
            <p><b>Inputs:</p>
            </b>
            <ul>
            <li><b>Sys Id</b> - Sys Id of the application on which you wish to apply changes from source control. To apply changes for customization for store application, provide Sys Id for the store application.</li>
            <li><b>Instance URL</b> - The URL of the Instance where app needs to be updated. </li>
            <li><b>Credential Alias</b> - The Connection and Credential alias must be of type "Credential" and must have user with "sn_cicd.sys_ci_automation" role."</li>
            <li><b>Branch Name</b> - Branch Name of the source control repo from which changes will be applied to application. </li>
            <li><b>Auto Upgrade Base Application</b> - This field will only be used when changes are applied for customization to store application. Should be set to false if base store app should not be upgraded if the latest Git commit to apply is built on newer version of base app than what is installed on the instance. Else leave it empty as default is true.  </li>
            <li><b>API Version</b> - This optional parameter allows the version of the related CICD REST API to be specified.  When not present, the latest version of the API will be used.</li>
            </ul>
            <p><b>Outputs:</p>
            </b>
            <ul>
            <li><b>Status</b> - Will be set to "0", if the request is "Pending". Will be set to "1", if the request is in "Running" state. Will be set to "2", if the request is "Successful". Will be set to "3", if the request is "Failed". Will be set to "4", if the request is "Cancelled”. </li>
            <li><b>Error</b> - Reason for error. Populated only when an error occurs. </li>
            <li><b>HTTP Status</b> - The HTTP status code of the response</li>
            <li><b>Status Label</b> - The label corresponding to the 'status'. Will be one of "Pending", "Running", "Successful", "Failed", "Cancelled"</li>
            <li><b>Status Message</b> - More information on why the operation failed if available. Can be empty. </li>
            <li><b>Status Detail</b> - More details on why the operation failed if available. Can be empty. </li>
            <li><b>Stash ID</b> - The sys_id of the sys_repo_stash record. Can be used to uniquely identify a stash from the sys_repo_stash records.</li>
            <li><b>Stash URL</b> - The URL of REST endpoint to apply the stashed changes from sys_id of the sys_repo_stash record.</li>
            </ul>
            <p> To use this action, a corresponding CICD connection and credential must be created and associated with the Instance URL used above.  <a target="_blank" href="https://docs.servicenow.com/search?q=Create+a+Connection+%26+Credential+alias">Learn More</a></p></description><display_name_after_preview/><flow_priority/><generation_source/><internal_name>import_application_with_id</internal_name><label_cache>[{"name":"c55185b9-a623-4cad-9651-413f9f6145ca.__dont_treat_as_error__","label":"7 display_value="Source Control">a5bdd866773f3300d4bdaeca78106196</category><copied_from/><copied_from_name/><description><p>This flow will apply remote changes from source control on an application with a given sys_id on the provided instance. </p>
            <p><b>Inputs:</p>
            </b>
            <ul>
            <li><b>Sys Id</b> - Sys Id of the application on which you wish to apply changes from source control. To apply changes for customization for store application, provide Sys Id for the store application.</li>
            <li><b>Instance URL</b> - The URL of the Instance where app needs to be updated. </li>
            <li><b>Credential Alias</b> - The Connection and Credential alias must be of type "Credential" and must have user with "sn_cicd.sys_ci_automation" role."</li>
            <li><b>Branch Name</b> - Branch Name of the source control repo from which changes will be applied to application. </li>
            <li><b>Auto Upgrade Base Application</b> - This field will only be used when changes are applied for customization to store application. Should be set to false if base store app should not be upgraded if the latest Git commit to apply is built on newer version of base app than what is installed on the instance. Else leave it empty as default is true.  </li>
            <li><b>API Version</b> - This optional parameter allows the version of the related CICD REST API to be specified.  When not present, the latest version of the API will be used.</li>
            </ul>
            <p><b>Outputs:</p>
            </b>
            <ul>
            <li><b>Status</b> - Will be set to "0", if the request is "Pending". Will be set to "1", if the request is in "Running" state. Will be set to "2", if the request is "Successful". Will be set to "3", if the request is "Failed". Will be set to "4", if the request is "Cancelled”. </li>
            <li><b>Error</b> - Reason for error. Populated only when an error occurs. </li>
            <li><b>HTTP Status</b> - The HTTP status code of the response</li>
            <li><b>Status Label</b> - The label corresponding to the 'status'. Will be one of "Pending", "Running", "Successful", "Failed", "Cancelled"</li>
            <li><b>Status Message</b> - More information on why the operation failed if available. Can be empty. </li>
            <li><b>Status Detail</b> - More details on why the operation failed if available. Can be empty. </li>
            <li><b>Stash ID</b> - The sys_id of the sys_repo_stash record. Can be used to uniquely identify a stash from the sys_repo_stash records.</li>
            <li><b>Stash URL</b> - The URL of REST endpoint to apply the stashed changes from sys_id of the sys_repo_stash record.</li>
            </ul>
            <p> To use this action, a corresponding CICD connection and credential must be created and associated with the Instance URL used above.  <a target="_blank" href="https://docs.servicenow.com/search?q=Create+a+Connection+%26+Credential+alias">Learn
